pageSubtitle: Metrics 8–10 — Dormant Rate, Lost Customer Value, and Reactivation Rate
m8TooltipInfo: "Dormant" means a customer whose last transaction has passed the inactive-month threshold. The threshold varies by division business category (B2B Distributor, B2B Project, B2C, Manufacturing), configured in Settings → Threshold.
m8TooltipClickHint: Click to view dormant customer list
m8TopCustomersInfo: Sorted by highest estimated loss (average monthly revenue over the last 12 months before going dormant × months dormant)
m9TooltipInfo: Sorted by highest lost value. Estimate = average monthly revenue over the last 12 months before going dormant × months dormant.
m9TooltipClickHint: Click to view the customer's revenue history
m10TooltipInfo: "Reactivated" means a customer who was previously dormant (past the inactive-month threshold), transacted again, and is back to active status by the end of this period. Reactivation Rate = number of reactivations divided by the total customers who were dormant in the previous period.
m10TooltipClickHint: Click to view the list of reactivated customers
m10ReactivationEmpty: No reactivated customers in this period
m10TopCustomersInfo: Sorted by most recent reactivation date; ties broken by highest average monthly revenue
